items.title: 9.2.2 Key Parts of a Business Plan

source_refs.note: Topic 9.2.2 with the business-plan class activity (PDF 210-211, printed 207-209). The chai-dhaba business description is printed after the financial plan, out of order; the $100 example uses dollars. Short question 3 and long question 2 are answered.

blocks.caption: Key parts of a business plan
rows: Executive summary
a brief overview: what the business does, its goals and how
the most important points in short
Business description
products or services, target customers, what is unique
a chai dhaba with freshly brewed chai near the bazaar
Market analysis
customers, their needs and competitors
pet owners and other pet-sitting services nearby
Organization and management
how the business is organized; team and roles
a school club's president and secretary
Products or services
features and benefits
how tutoring lessons raise grades
Marketing and sales strategy
how to attract and keep customers
a crafts business using social media and local fairs
Financial plan
budget, funding needs and expected revenue
how to raise money for supplies and what it will earn
